judge.evidence_requirement: Use exact observed Skill lifecycle evidence for activation. Judge output quality separately.

dimensions.description: Code Review activates for direct review outcomes and stays inactive when implementation or the reviewed-ticket lifecycle owns the request.

evals.name: canonical Code Review invocation
evals.prompt:
/code-review

Review this complete Ticket outcome and return the local Review brief.
evals.expected_output: The exact Code Review lifecycle and canonical dependency closure load.
expectations: Exact successful Code Review and dependency loads are observed.

evals.name: ambient complete review request
evals.prompt: Review the complete immutable Ticket outcome and return evidence-backed findings without changing code.
evals.expected_output: Code Review owns the requested read-only review outcome.
expectations: Code Review activates independently from semantic output quality.

evals.name: implementation exclusion
evals.prompt: Implement this settled ticket with TDD and return its implementation handoff.
evals.expected_output: Implement owns the patch and Code Review stays inactive.
expectations: No Code Review selection or load is observed.

evals.name: Take Ticket exclusion
evals.prompt: Take this ticket through implementation, independent review, correction, and targeted re-review.
evals.expected_output: Take Ticket owns the complete lifecycle and Code Review is not selected as another public outcome.
expectations: No independent Code Review public-outcome activation is observed.
